consequence.statement: The shipped default promtail config for rpm/deb packages changed to avoid possible high CPU use with many files in /var/log; the evidence does not state any failure.

original.statement: The default promtail configuration shipped with rpm/deb packages was improved to avoid possible high CPU utilisation when /var/log contains many files.

decision.reason: [ev-d546fd91b679] says only that the default promtail configuration shipped with the rpm/deb packages was improved to avoid possible high CPU use when /var/log holds many files. Nothing there says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. A changed packaged default that keeps working is a behavior-change, so review-required with low severity fits. Confidence is low because the evidence doesn't say which settings changed.
